generate_proto_from_file: generate a _pb2.py file from a .proto source file using the Protocol Compiler
build_py_with_proto_gen: build the protobuf python package while auto-generating _pb2.py files from proto sources
setup_protobuf_package: configure and install the protobuf package with conditional dependencies for Python 2.7 or earlier
review_generate_proto_function: review the generate_proto function to understand how it invokes protoc with custom include paths
refactor_build_py_class: refactor the build_py class to support additional proto files or different protoc binaries
